facts.value: Regulates and enforces environmental law. Primary entity for hazardous waste, illegal dumping of toxic/medical materials, and environmental pollution incidents.
NOT responsible for regular municipal solid waste — that is the municipality's scope. MOE handles hazardous, medical, industrial, or toxic waste.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-005 distinguishes hazardous medical waste (MOE + HITL) from regular garbage (MUN).

facts.value: Official environmental complaint channels: submit a dated/signed complaint through MoE official channels, call hotline 1789, fax 01 976535, or email complaints@moe.gov.lb.
facts.notes: Verified 2026-05-24 on the official MoE environmental complaints page. Hazardous/medical waste still requires HITL because of public-health and legal-risk assessment, not because the contact channel is unknown.

facts.value: Nationwide. Cross-sector authority for environmental compliance.
No published SLA. HITL always required for environmental/hazardous waste routing. CedarFix classifies these as escalated.

secondary_for_sectors: WASTE (escalation of unresolved municipal dumping with environmental risk)
hitl_conditions: All hazardous/medical waste routing requires HITL because of public-health and evidence-risk assessment
Use official MoE complaint channels only after confirming issue is environmental/hazardous, not regular municipal waste
